result.summary: Removes 21.ninja from the list of seed sources used by the release seed generator script and cleans up obsolete documentation referencing sipa's previously removed seed. It avoids ingesting stale peer data and eliminates the risk of an unmaintained external domain being hijacked to inject malicious addresses into hardcoded release seeds.
result.problem: The seeds.txt.gz file hosted on 21.ninja has not been updated since May 2026 because the operator stepped away from development. Feeding unmaintained seed lists into makeseeds.py risks incorporating stale peer addresses and exposes future releases to address poisoning if the domain expires or is compromised.
evidence: "The seeds.txt.gz file was last generated on 2026-05-22... This is about 6 months old now... keeping the domain around just risks someone else getting access to the host or domain to insert malicious or fake addresses into it." (PR description and commit 6b27e165e2)
"My understanding is that the owner of 21.ninja stepped away from Bitcoin development and probably will not maintain the seeder going forward." (PR description)
result.card: This PR removes 21.ninja as a seed data source for makeseeds.py and removes stale documentation referencing sipa's seed. The 21.ninja seed file has been unmaintained since May 2026, meaning makeseeds.py would ingest stale addresses and expose static seed generation to domain hijacking risks if the host is ever compromised. Removing dormant sources protects the integrity of hardcoded DNS and IP seed lists shipped in future releases.

risk.why: It only modifies the offline seed extraction tooling and docs in contrib/seeds, slightly narrowing the set of seed sources used before release builds.
